name: Kirloskar Pneumatic Co Ltd (KPCL)
tagline: ~Rs 9,600 Cr mid-cap air/gas compression and process-gas engineering business enjoying a genuine margin step-up (OPM ~19% -> ~26%) on operating leverage, aftermarket mix and gas/defence orders - a quality compounder, but too large for a 10x/100x thesis
business_overview: Kirloskar Pneumatic Co Ltd (NSE: KIRLPNU), part of the Kirloskar group, makes air and gas compressors, process-gas systems (CNG/PNG compression, gas gathering, refrigeration), air-conditioning & refrigeration, marine HVACR, pneumatic tools and hydraulic power-transmission machinery. It also does turnkey process-gas projects and a growing high-margin aftermarket/spares business.
fundamentals_table: 2026-04-28: Q4FY26 sales +20% YoY to Rs 712 Cr; net profit +79% YoY to Rs 144 Cr; OPM 19% -> 26%; QoQ PAT +246%
fundamentals_narrative: KPCL is a well-run mid-cap: ~Rs 1,788 Cr revenue, ~Rs 264 Cr PAT, ~19% ROE, ~40% ROIC, net-cash, with a clear margin step-up - Q4FY26 operating margin ~26% against ~19% a year earlier and PAT +79% YoY. The drivers are real: operating leverage as project revenue scales, a richer aftermarket/spares mix, and order flow in process-gas (city-gas compression, gas gathering) and defence. But these are the marks of good execution in a good business, not a specific named management or structural inflection of the kind that would justify keeping a genuine mid-cap out of 'neither'. A 10x from ~Rs 9,600 Cr implies ~Rs 96,000 Cr; 100x in ten years is not credible. The stock already trades at ~36x earnings, so the margin step-up is at least partly in the price.

earnings_quality.normalised_note: A jump to ~26% operating margin from a ~19% base in one year is unlikely to be fully through-cycle; project mix and execution timing can pull it back toward low-20s. Treat current margin as above mid-cycle.

growth_trajectory.last_quarters_note: Recent quarters show revenue mid-teens-to-20% YoY with PAT growing much faster (Q4FY26 PAT +79% YoY, QoQ +246%) as margins expanded - profit growth running well ahead of revenue growth.
growth_trajectory.reverse_pe_note: ~36x trailing needs high-teens+ sustained EPS growth; the margin step-up is partly priced, so the gap is 'partially-priced' at best and depends on the margin holding.

management_quality.capital_allocation: Reinvests in gas / process-engineering capacity and aftermarket; net-cash balance sheet; Kirloskar-group governance broadly clean at this entity

bull_case: Genuine margin step-up (OPM ~19% -> ~26%) on operating leverage, aftermarket mix and process-gas/defence orders
High-quality financials: ~19% ROE, ~40% ROIC, net-cash, rising ROCE
Structural tailwinds in city-gas distribution compression and defence indigenisation
Group pedigree, clean governance at the entity level
bear_case: Genuine mid-cap (~Rs 9,600 Cr) - a 10x implies ~Rs 96,000 Cr; 100x-in-10-years not credible
Margin expansion is execution/mix-led, not a named structural inflection - and ~26% OPM carries peak-margin risk
Already ~36x earnings - the step-up is at least partly priced
Project revenue lumpiness; margin can retrace on mix
verdict_headline: Quality mid-cap compounder with a real margin step-up, but size math and the absence of a named structural inflection keep it 'neither'; conviction Medium
verdict_reasoning: Sovrenn-news seed (tier 4.65). The Sovrenn trigger holds up - Q4FY26 PAT +79% YoY on an OPM jump to ~26% is consistent with operating leverage plus a richer aftermarket / process-gas / defence mix in a genuinely well-run business.

Per the large-cap / mid-cap inflection rule, a genuine mid-cap (~Rs 9,600 Cr) defaults to 'neither' on size math unless there is a specific named management or structural inflection. KPCL's improvement is good management executing well in a good business - explicitly the case the rule excludes - so thesis_fit stays 'neither'. Noted for the max-returns ranking as a quality compounder with gas-genset/process-gas and defence exposure (priority-1 theme adjacency).
No red flag (net-cash, clean group governance, no SEBI/auditor issue). peak_margin_risk flagged true (26% OPM above mid-cycle). conviction Medium; revisit_after_30d false.

four_box.note: Process-gas/defence order flow is good execution, not a structural inflection per fundamentals_narrative (tailwind weak); explicit size math (~Rs9,600cr, 10x implies ~Rs96,000cr) rules out tam; aftermarket lock-in + engineering know-how is a real moat; ~36x earnings already partly prices the margin step-up, and earnings_quality flags peak_margin_risk — valuation no.
